scripts.start: concurrently 'cd server/src/mtcute && bun index.ts' 'cd server && bun run start' 'cd client && bun run dev'
scripts.dev: concurrently 'cd server && bun run start' 'cd client && bun run dev'
scripts.setup: bun install && cd client && bun install && cd ../server && bun install && bun prisma generate
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd client lint && bun run --cwd server lint
scripts.fix: bun run --cwd client fix && bun run --cwd server fix
scripts.format: bun run --cwd client format && bun run --cwd server format
